verified_inputs.role: Active record, provenance, dependency, and witness blocker

authorized: Define provisional boundary, domain, and residue context mapping-rule candidates.
Define candidate completeness rules for target-level non-relation.
Declare applicability, evaluation, authority, provenance, and dependency contracts for later records.
not_authorized: Instantiate carrier or context mapping records.
Promote any candidate to canonical authority.

type_scope.source_operands: X,Z : RT_OR_ART_TYPED_OPERAND; exact governed source declarations remain unresolved.
type_scope.source_context: Y : SOURCE_COMPOSITION_CONTEXT; exact governed context declaration remains unresolved.
type_scope.observation_target: o : ObservationOrientation; provisional target parameter with Applicability_x(o;D_rel).
type_scope.boundary_target: B_x : BoundaryInteraction_x; provisional role-scoped target parameter.
type_scope.domain_target: D_rel : RelationalDomain_x; provisional role-scoped target parameter.
type_scope.residue_target: R : Residue_x; provisional role-scoped target parameter.

PositiveRuleEvaluationResult_x[W,N,U].guard: REJECTS_RULE_ONLY rejects only the evaluated positive rule family; it never establishes target-level DOES_NOT_RELATE.

RelationDeterminationResult_x[W,N,U].guard: DOES_NOT_RELATE requires complete applicable-rule-set evidence and cannot be emitted by a single positive rule.

candidate_rule_definitions.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR EXTRACTED(a_x) and the governed aspect relation returns REJECTS(n_local).
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Any source type, target applicability, extractor, relation evaluator, authority, provenance, context, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No D(X|Z)>epsilon_src or d_obs(o_i,o_j)>epsilon_obs outcome participates in applicability or evaluation.

candidate_rule_definitions.local_rejection_condition: A governed applicable source-target class pair exists and GovernedClassBridge_x returns REJECTS(n_local).
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Any class field, bridge, applicability, authority, provenance, context, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No source or observation distinction-floor outcome participates in applicability or evaluation.

applicability_conditions: Declared exact source and target types.
Every applicable carrier rule has a governed RuleAuthorityRecord_x.
Every applicable carrier rule has independently validated provenance.
PRE_REF_ORIENT dependency completeness is independently established.
candidate_rule_definitions.does_not_relate_condition: All authorized applicable carrier positive rules return REJECTS_RULE_ONLY and complete governed analysis establishes no additional applicable carrier rule.
candidate_rule_definitions.falsification_condition: Any authorized applicable carrier rule returns SUPPORTS_RELATION.
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Rule-set completeness, rule authority, provenance, applicability, exact typing, or dependency evidence is incomplete.
candidate_rule_definitions.global_guard: Absence of a discovered rule is not complete non-relation evidence.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No threshold agreement or disagreement establishes this result.

candidate_rule_definitions.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR EXTRACTED(b_y) and the governed boundary relation returns REJECTS(n_local).
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Any context type, target applicability, extractor, relation evaluator, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No source or observation distinction-floor outcome participates.

candidate_rule_definitions.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR EXTRACTED(d_y) and the governed domain relation returns REJECTS(n_local).
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Any context type, target applicability, extractor, relation evaluator, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No source or observation distinction-floor outcome participates.

candidate_rule_definitions.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR EXTRACTED(r_y) and the governed residue relation returns REJECTS(n_local).
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Any context history/type, target applicability, extractor, relation evaluator, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
candidate_rule_definitions.threshold_independence: No source or observation distinction-floor outcome participates.

candidate_rule_definitions.does_not_relate_condition: CompleteApplicableBoundaryRuleSet_x(Y,B_x) AND all authorized applicable boundary rules return REJECTS_RULE_ONLY AND NoAdditionalApplicableAuthorizedBoundaryRule_x(Y,B_x).
candidate_rule_definitions.falsification_condition: Any authorized applicable boundary rule returns SUPPORTS_RELATION.
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Boundary rule-set completeness, rule authority, provenance, applicability, exact typing, or dependency evidence is incomplete.

candidate_rule_definitions.does_not_relate_condition: CompleteApplicableDomainRuleSet_x(Y,D_rel) AND all authorized applicable domain rules return REJECTS_RULE_ONLY AND NoAdditionalApplicableAuthorizedDomainRule_x(Y,D_rel).
candidate_rule_definitions.falsification_condition: Any authorized applicable domain rule returns SUPPORTS_RELATION.
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Domain rule-set completeness, rule authority, provenance, applicability, exact typing, or dependency evidence is incomplete.

candidate_rule_definitions.does_not_relate_condition: CompleteApplicableResidueRuleSet_x(Y,R) AND all authorized applicable residue rules return REJECTS_RULE_ONLY AND NoAdditionalApplicableAuthorizedResidueRule_x(Y,R).
candidate_rule_definitions.falsification_condition: Any authorized applicable residue rule returns SUPPORTS_RELATION.
candidate_rule_definitions.undefined_condition: Residue rule-set completeness, rule authority, provenance, applicability, exact typing, or dependency evidence is incomplete.

derived_global_candidate.guard: A relation to one target falsifies the global conjunction and decides only that target; it does not decide either remaining target.

rule_authority_contract.requirement: Each candidate rule must receive an independent RuleAuthorityRecord_x before it may be treated as governed or included in an applicable-rule-set completeness claim.
rule_authority_contract.construction_authority_non_equivalence: The human decision authorizes candidate definition construction; it is not a RuleAuthorityRecord_x for any candidate.

provenance_contract.requirement: Every future governed rule and mapping record must carry independently validated lineage to the source hypotheses, reviews, construction decision, and exact type declarations.
provenance_contract.absence_guard: Artifact citation alone does not establish semantic provenance completeness.

dependency_contract.requirement: PRE_REF_ORIENT availability must be established by an independently extracted dependency graph and completeness record.
dependency_contract.evaluation_effect: Until dependency completeness is verified, every candidate rule evaluation remains UNDEFINED even when its local syntactic conditions appear satisfied.

completeness_contract.carrier: CompleteApplicableCarrierRuleSet_x cannot be asserted until all candidate and externally governed carrier rules for the exact typed pair have authority, provenance, applicability, and dependency decisions.
completeness_contract.boundary: CompleteApplicableBoundaryRuleSet_x cannot be asserted until the boundary rule family is independently closed.
completeness_contract.domain: CompleteApplicableDomainRuleSet_x cannot be asserted until the domain rule family is independently closed.
completeness_contract.residue: CompleteApplicableResidueRuleSet_x cannot be asserted until the residue rule family is independently closed.
completeness_contract.negative_evidence_guard: Repository search exhaustion is not equivalent to semantic rule-set completeness.

review_questions: Are positive-rule local rejection and target-level non-relation sufficiently separated?
Are the carrier aspect and class mediation candidates exhaustive enough to begin authority review without claiming rule-set completeness?
Are boundary, domain, and residue targets still correctly provisional?
Does PRE_REF_ORIENT dependency completeness remain an independent prerequisite?
Should any additional positive carrier or context rule family be hypothesized before rule authority review begins?
next_authorized_action: Independent review of the nine MAP-04 candidate rule definitions only.
